artifacts.summary: 10-phase, 15-hour plan restoring Saturation (S1-directed) as def:frame's fourth constraint, landing the nest condition S1 with the S1d-implies-S1 check, the correction that both existing witnesses refute S1, and the countable-domain sufficiency result, then reversing 17 in-tree prose regions.

user_decision.question: Research raised this as non-blocking in the prior cycle and it was not answered, so it is re-raised once here because it fixes def:frame's fourth constraint. Question 1 is settled only in part: S1 (the textbook nest condition) provably suffices for lem:step over every history with a countable domain, which covers all of Z-time and Q-time; it does not suffice in general, and the separating frame that would prove that needs a Hahn group over omega_1 as duration type -- a research-scale Lean construction with no Mathlib support. How should Question 1 be closed? The plan is written to option 1; picking another changes only Phase 1's def:frame choice and register, not the four new theorems.
options: Close on the naturalness verdict -- keep S_1^d as def:frame's fourth constraint, land the countable-domain sufficiency theorem plus the correction that both existing witnesses also refute S_1, and declare the Hahn-group separating frame an explicit non-goal with its recipe recorded (this is what the plan does)
Close only after the separating frame -- hold Question 1 open and scope the omega_1 Hahn-group construction as implementation work in this task
Close on the sufficiency theorem alone -- adopt S_1 as def:frame's fourth constraint and accept that lem:step then carries an order-character hypothesis on the history's domain
user_decision.recommended: Close on the naturalness verdict -- keep S_1^d as def:frame's fourth constraint, land the countable-domain sufficiency theorem plus the correction that both existing witnesses also refute S_1, and declare the Hahn-group separating frame an explicit non-goal with its recipe recorded (this is what the plan does)

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's value rests on proving a result WITHOUT a particular axiom (e.g. 'condition X suffices, Saturation is not needed'), check whether the supporting lemmas are bound to a BUNDLED typeclass that carries that axiom. In BimodalLogic, fiber/segment monotonicity lemmas were stated at [F.IsRegular], a class bundling Compositionality, Seriality, Limit AND Saturation; any 'Saturation-free' theorem proved through them would have been silently vacuous. The fix is a hypothesis-weakening phase that restates each supporting lemma with the single explicit hypothesis its proof actually consumes and demotes the original to a one-line corollary, so no call site changes. Schedule that phase BEFORE the phases that depend on the honesty, and add a verification gate ('no theorem in this section carries the instance binder'). Generalizes to any codebase where axioms are bundled into a structure or typeclass and an independence/minimality result is wanted.
